name: com.arcadebasic.interpreter
description:
Arcade BASIC: a Full BASIC (ISO/IEC 10279:1991) interpreter for Unity. Run BASIC programs from C# for in-game scripting, dialogue, modding, education, or demos.

Features: arrays, MAT operations, file I/O, exception handling (WHEN/USE/HANDLER), modules, PRINT USING, INPUT, codepoint-aware strings, arbitrary-precision decimal arithmetic.

See README.md inside the package for quickstart and the Arcade BASIC IDE sample for a working scene wiring.

samples.description: A drop-in in-game IDE: prefab + scene with menu bar (File/Run), syntax-highlighted source pane, output transcript, INPUT bar, Problems pane, and Build Standalone support.
